name: Room list sections
description: Adds a Settings tab to show or hide each room-list section (Unreads, People, Rooms, Mentions, Invites, Low priority) and adds a new 'Latest' section that lists every conversation (rooms and chats) in chronological order, newest message first. Toggling 'Low priority' off removes low-priority rooms from the room list in every mode.
author: jere344
